n: 5.0 Cu. Ft. Mega Capacity Front Load Washer
desc: This LG high efficiency washer uses far less water and energy than a conventional washer for savings that add up with each load. LG's True Balance Anti-Vibration and LoDecibel systems are designed for quiet operation that keeps even big loads in balance to reduce washer noise and vibration.
hl: CLEANS LIKE WARM, SAVES LIKE COLD
Powered by the LG Direct Drive Motor and 6 motion™ technology, ColdWash™ technology penetrates deep into fabrics, for cold water savings with warm water performance.
Backed by a 10-year limited warranty, the LG Direct Drive Motor delivers peace of mind with every load.
SAVE WATER, SAVE ENERGY, SAVE MONEY
This LG high efficiency washer uses far less water and energy than a conventional washer for savings that add up with each load.
PUT PEACE AND QUIET BACK INTO YOUR DAY
LG's True Balance® Anti-Vibration and LoDecibel® systems are designed for quiet operation that keeps even big loads in balance to reduce washer noise and vibration.
GO BIG TO SAVE TIME AND GET MORE DONE
With Mega Capacity (5.0 cu. ft.), you can fit a king-size comforter and more in a single load, for big time savings every week.
FLEXIBILITY TO FIT ALMOST ANY SPACE
This washer is worth showing off, but when space dictates otherwise it’s good to know it'll easily fit in almost any closet with plenty of room to close the closet door.
